conflicts_and_limits: No quantitative phase purity; author explicitly uncertain XRD assignment
Chemically prepared comparator is ramsdellite, not abiotic birnessite; area/porosity/organic content also differ
Freeze-dried sorbent, no demonstrated ongoing fungal metabolism or measured viability
Methods up to 175 micromol/L Co versus Figure 7 approximately 0.21 mmol/L and unshown 0.55 mmol/L prose
Reported 160/28.7 mmol Co per mol Mn and 5.6-fold advantage not readily reconstructed from displayed concentration loss and nominal Mn; no accepted quantitative superiority
Abstract prioritizes Mn(IV) reaction; body prioritizes Mn(III); no unique preferred Mn oxidant accepted
XPS is ex situ surface evidence, not bulk CoOOH assignment or closed redox balance

Preparation calls collected precipitate filtrate in freeze-drying sentence; sorption vessel dm3 vs preparation cm3; implausible chemical-comparator concentrations retained as source issues, not normalized
Formation lacks displayed time-matched sterile series; downstream fungus-only and no-Co controls are present
No recovery product, regeneration yield or industrial deployment demonstrated
